title: /api/diag/live_review_due takes ~19 s; find and fix the slow read
note: Measured 2026-11-12 01:46Z: 19.1 s wall time for one call (8 due of 18 open). The 01:45Z live-review wake hit diag_fetch's 10 s budget and reported could_not_look while 8 packages were due. Stopgap #25064 sets DIAG_FETCH_MAX_TIME=45 in live-review-wake.yml. Done when the route answers under 5 s (profile it: per-package broker reads? journal scans?) with the same output. [2026-11-12 09:35Z AM-TRADING] Bundled with RM-AM-DUE-COULDNOTLOOK into ONE lane (same route; spawn requested 09:31Z). Re-measured 09:2xZ: 10 s timeout then HTTP 502 after ~31 s.
